model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Calm luminous paper-cut watercolour and gouache science storybook on cream paper; rain-blue, leaf-green and sunny-yellow; precise, safe urban-water diagrams.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Bangkok-like city in gentle rain with distinct canal, pump station, retention pond and working gutters; exact recurring cast dry under a bus shelter umbrella; quiet title space; no text.

images.name: hard-surfaces
images.prompt: Equal-rain split cutaway: arrows descend into porous field soil, while roof and road runoff stays on hard surfaces and reaches a curb gutter.

images.name: drains-and-pipes
images.prompt: Two curb inlets and chambers join one right-flowing underground pipe ending at a canal headwall; separate manholes and a street-grate close-up.

images.name: canals
images.prompt: Bangkok canal with connected street outfalls, downstream arrows, moored longtail boat and clear pipe < canal < river width.

images.name: floodgates
images.prompt: Two stacked states of one gate: canal drains to lower river through raised gate; higher river is stopped by fully closed gate; level bars only.

images.name: pumps
images.prompt: Lower canal and higher river separated by closed gate; connected pipe and impeller lift water continuously into river.

images.name: deep-tunnels
images.prompt: Vertical city cutaway with foundations above a deep round drainage tunnel; street shaft descends to right-flowing tunnel and one pumped river outfall.

images.name: monkey-cheek
images.prompt: Square split park: full retention pond and canal during rain, then lower pond releasing once through a small outlet to lower canal; calm walkers and friendly food-filled monkey cheek inset.

images.name: one-team
images.prompt: Connected city summary: inlet, pipe, canal, closed gate plus pump route, river, deep tunnel, and retention pond with later outlet; correct arrows only.

images.name: closing
images.prompt: Exact cast walks home dry in the same city after rain; quiet pump house, one identifiable retention pond and exactly one gentle outlet to the canal; birds and warm evening.
